pr_body:
Also fix 2 existing bugs:
1. ContentRootPath is set to the app's BaseDirectory, and not CurrentWorkingDirectory. Default to CWD by using the same logic as HostApplicationBuilder.
2. Add un-prefixed environment variables to the configuration, and ensure the configuration order is the same as WebApplication.CreateBuilder.

Fix #46293

issue_context.title: Update CreateSlimBuilder for Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Host.CreateEmptyApplicationBuilder
issue_context.body:
Once https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/81280 is implemented, we should take advantage of this new API in CreateSlimBuilder:

https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/4d75ee9a7fbad112e29b8a1d77c7d96965f62b40/src/DefaultBuilder/src/WebApplicationBuilder.cs#L105-L113

This should cut about **1.3 MB** of a NativeAOT published Windows x64 app. Prototyping this change on my machine results the [Benchmark app](https://github.com/aspnet/Benchmarks/tree/main/src/Goldilocks):

**Before**
15.2 MB (16,007,168 bytes)

**After**
13.9 MB (14,593,024 bytes)

And **1.4MB** on Linux x64:

**Before**
18.6 MB (19,601,424 bytes)

**After**
17.2 MB (18,132,768 bytes)

review_comments: You could do this before adding any configuration, right? SetDefaultContentRoot tries not to override any explicit config, so order shouldn't really matter. If we do it first, we could probably get rid of `configuration[HostDefaults.ContentRootKey] is null`, but I understand keeping it the same for consistency.
Yeah, it probably could, but I like keeping the logic consistent, so if we ever need to update one it would be straight forward to update the other.
